client_frame: **Wed was a classic risk-on-with-cracks session.** DJI made another verified ATH close (54,349 / high 54,744). SPX printed a new intraday high (7,793.68) then closed −0.17% below Tue's close ATH — not a close record. NDX −0.83% remains a recovery trade (−3.8% under June ATH), dragged by AMD's second day of post-print fade (~−7% Wed after −8–9% AH Tue). **Labor is cooling into NFP**: ADP +44k missed hard vs 65–75k, and ISM Services Employment fell back to 47.4 contraction even as headline services stayed in expansion (54.1). That combination — soft private payrolls + services hiring back in contraction — raises the odds of a sub-100k NFP Friday and extends the bull-steepener path, unless AHE stays hot. **LLY already reported Wed** (not today): blowout $8.38 EPS / $22.97B rev on GLP-1 — calendar corrected. **Iran remains the oil trap**: prices keep sliding on deal hopes while actual Hormuz tanker traffic is still ~75% below pre-crisis (Kpler/Lloyd's). **Client**: (1) DJI strength is real price discovery; NDX is not — size tech accordingly; (2) soft ADP is a gift for duration and a warning for cyclicals if NFP confirms; (3) do not treat oil weakness as permanent until tanker counts recover; (4) VIX 15.81 after spiking to 18.43 on ADP is still cheap NFP insurance; (5) Fri NFP (cons ~+83–91k) + AHE is the week's real catalyst under Warsh.
